title: Shrouded Glade Gloam Invasion

facts.statement: Shrouded Glade was under siege by the Gloam, whose influence poured down from the Dawn Cascade and Daybreak Falls through the Gloamstones; Sunstone Dwarves and Shrouded Glade Druids were already fighting it.
facts.quote: Shrouded Glade is under Siege! The Gloam's influence is pouring down from the Dawn Cascade and Daybreak Falls

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: SOE news post (captured June 2012, originally shown as 'Sunstone Valley and the Gloam Invasion!', posted 3 days 22 hours before capture; no absolute date given) announcing a Gloam invasion of Shrouded Glade with combat against Gloamstone-warped monsters, and an early look at Sunstone Valley, which the post says was not yet in the game. It names locations Wheelie Pete's, the Rumbledome and the Oasis in Sunstone Valley.

quest_answers_mentioning_it: This Glade is Ours! (unresolved, live yes)
